newsitem.title: KENYA: Nairobi share index falls in calm trading.
newsitem.headline: Nairobi share index falls in calm trading.

text.p: The Nairobi Stock Exchange 20-share index fell on Thursday in a calm market, brokers said.
The index fell 10.86 to stand at 3065.41. Turnover was posted at 6.295 million shillings on 238,733 shares from 38.649 million shillings on 842,229 shares.

Brokers said the market was calm as only small lots were traded on the general trading floor. This compared to a Wednesday turnover that had been boosted by heavy buying of shares from the special lots and foreign investors boards.
Kenya Airways continued to improve with a total of 78,619 shares traded at 10.50 from 10.35 on Wednesday, on news the airline was one of the most profitable in the world.

In a survey done on airlines the national carrier Kenya Airways was ranked fifth among the 150 leading airlines in the 1995 category of best net margins in the world, the Kenya Airways information division announced late on Wednesday.
A senior broker said that announcement made a positive impact on the stock as most people gave it a second look.

The airline had dropped far below its June share flotation price of 11.25 shillings after it said its profits would be heavily undermined by a high court decision to award its pilots salary increases and arrears totalling 450 million shillings.
Among industrial stocks, Crown Berger Kenya Ltd was not traded after it reported a loss of 15.4 million shillings in the first six months to 30 June, 1996.
Crown Berger's last traded price was 14 shillings.
Elsewhere, British American Tobacco fell 2.0 shillings to 68 while Firestone East Africa eased to 23.50 from 24.
Among the plantations, Kakuzi rose to 92.50 from 90, Rea Vipingo eased to 11.20 from 11.25 while Brooke Bond was unchanged at 176.
Housing Finance Company of Kenya eased to 25 from 26, Kenya Commercial Bank fell to 55.50 from 58 and National Bank of Kenya traded a total of 50,850 shares at a stable price of 17.30.
